producer_report.summary:
Root cause: landing, history and attribution rules were derived from the happy-path commit shape (the job's own commits). The only guard was prose in the planner and critic prompts. Jobs 20261024-153908-1rve, 20261024-154552-e65v and 20261025-012657-hac3 each began from a reading whose criteria never required a branch with an intervention commit, a records-only commit and the job landing.

Fix, where readings are accepted: a new pure check, `check_history_fixture` in reading.rs, run as `step!(check_history_fixture(reading))` right after `check_code_survey` in `refusing_check`. It applies to code or tests readings with a behavior criterion, using one gate helper now shared with `check_code_survey`. It fires when any criterion holds a classification phrase or function name (`commit shape`, `pr_commits`, `classify_commit`, `history check`, `trailer`, `--history` and the like). File paths and the bare word `landing` do not fire it. It is met by a behavior criterion that names a realistic-branch fixture with an intervention commit, a records-only commit and the job landing. The error text gives an example criterion and asks for other shapes such as a retry-after-block landing. I did not fix one `pr_commits` or trailer instance because every landing rule passes this seam, and another instance fix would leave the next rule free to be tested only on job commits.

Other changes:
- The doc comment declares 'expected 4% of newly refused readings' as an estimate.
- The ENGM test fixture gains the fixture criterion.
- The CHANGELOG entry names the cause.
- New unit tests cover the three source-job shapes (each refused, then accepted), the not-refused shapes, the step line and the doc.
- Seven corpus cases and four input-form tags were added.
- The athena-context test now also asserts that the planner frame holds the three shapes.
- A test_support.rs doc paragraph says what the cutover fixture does not hold.

Limits: the match is lexical, and the retry-after-block landing is not enforced. There is no reader rule line, because this reading does not grow reader-facing text and briefs.rs is not a deliverable.

Checks: targeted tests, clippy, fmt, the policy scan and the full `cargo test --locked` all pass.

checks_run.note: 181 passed, including the new history_fixture_* tests, the updated ENGM test and the replay and refusal-rate tests
121 passed, including the extended landing_rules test

Full workspace suite, run once in the background; completed with exit code 0. It includes crates/athena-cli/tests/mirrors.rs. I learned the result from the completion notice, not from reading the output.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs gains a pub fn check_history_fixture(reading: &Reading) -> Result<()> whose doc comment names the root cause (rules derived from the happy-path commit shape, jobs 20261024-153908-1rve, 20261024-154552-e65v, 20261025-012657-hac3) and states 'expected N% of newly refused readings' with a whole-percent N.
criteria_check.evidence: Added after check_code_survey. The doc comment names the happy-path cause, the three job ids and 'expected 4% of newly refused readings'. Unit test history_fixture_doc_and_changelog_name_the_cause passes in `cargo test -p athena-core reading`. It checks the doc and the changelog item, and that replay_declaration parses the doc as share Some(4).

criteria_check.criterion: refusing_check in reading.rs calls the new check with step!(check_history_fixture(reading)), so the first-failure name and order stay derived from stringify!.
criteria_check.evidence: The step line sits right after step!(check_code_survey(reading)). Test history_fixture_has_one_step_line (passes) checks that it appears once, directly after the code-survey step, and that the check_reading_acceptance doc mentions it. The corpus mechanism test every_acceptance_check_has_a_refusing_corpus_case passes.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core reading`: a new unit test shows a code reading with a behavior criterion for a landing/history/attribution rule and no criterion naming a realistic-branch fixture with an intervention commit, a records-only commit and the job landing is refused with an error that says what to add; the same test shows the reading is accepted once such a criterion exists. The refusal test fails if the check is removed from refusing_check.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-core reading` passes (181 tests). history_fixture_refuses_a_rule_tested_only_on_job_commits, history_fixture_job_1rve_shape, history_fixture_job_e65v_shape and history_fixture_job_hac3_shape each assert refuser == Some("check_history_fixture"), check that the error text names the phrase, realistic-branch fixture, intervention commit, records-only commit, job landing and retry-after-block, then add the fixture criterion and assert acceptance. Without the step line, gate_refuser would return None and those assertions fail. history_fixture_refusal_needs_the_step_line pins the step line. I did not remove the step to watch the failure.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core reading`: a test shows readings unrelated to landing/history/attribution (docs, prompts, a code reading touching none of those) are not refused by the new check, and the existing replay/refusal-rate tests still pass.
criteria_check.evidence: history_fixture_leaves_unrelated_readings_alone passes. It covers a docs reading, a code reading touching none of it, CI-baseline, dispatch-branch and landing-queue shapes, a land.rs path alone, athena-data history.rs, a tests-class reading, a decline, a question, content-only criteria, a survey naming classify_commit, and the has_phrase boundaries. The existing replay tests pass in the same 181-test run.

criteria_check.criterion: Any reading fixtures in crates/ tests that legitimately touch landing or history rules are updated with the realistic-fixture criterion so existing tests stay valid, and the CHANGELOG.md entry names the root cause.
criteria_check.evidence: I searched crates/ for trigger phrases. Only the ENGM test (environment_reach_source_refuses_a_records_branch_read_in_the_engm_shape) builds a code reading with one. It now asserts check_history_fixture refuses it first, then adds the fixture criterion, and it passes. The other hits are class docs (corpus environment cases) or are not readings. The CHANGELOG Unreleased/Added entry names the happy-path cause and the three jobs. The doc test reads it.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`: all pass (the tested default).
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I also ran them: fmt --check and clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings are clean, and the full `cargo test --locked` completed with exit code 0.

criteria_check.criterion: The change description names the root cause and explains why it was fixed at the reading-stage check, where readings are accepted, not at one pr_commits or trailer instance.
criteria_check.evidence: The summary, the doc comment of check_history_fixture and the CHANGELOG entry state this. The doc test checks 'where readings are accepted'. git status shows only the five planned files changed. land.rs, gh.rs, invariant.rs, commits.rs, briefs.rs and athena-git are untouched.

open_issues: Departure from the plan's file list: crates/athena-core/tests/refusal_corpus.rs also changed (additive: 7 cases, 4 INPUT_FORMS tags taking it from 30 to 34, and history_fixture_refusal_is_declared_intended), because every_acceptance_check_has_a_refusing_corpus_case needs a refusing case for the new check. No existing case or check order changed.
The 4% share is an estimate from the plan (about 8 of the last 200 commits touched classification, history or attribution behavior), not a measurement. The replay at verification will measure it.

There is no reader rule line for this check, so a first landing reading will likely be refused once and corrected from the refusal text. Adding a READING_RULES line in briefs.rs is a possible follow-up.
The retry-after-block landing and other branch shapes are not enforced; the planner's commit-shape table remains the guard. The doc comment, the CHANGELOG entry and the refusal text say so.
mistakes: I submitted a first report before the background full-suite run finished and recorded it as not run. It finished with exit code 0; this report corrects that.
learnings: every_acceptance_check_has_a_refusing_corpus_case in refusal_corpus.rs fails when a step!(check_ line has no refusing corpus case, so a new reading check needs corpus cases and INPUT_FORMS tags.
has_phrase tests only char::is_alphanumeric at each end, so '_' and '-' count as word boundaries.
Corpus cases with deliverables outside the small repo_files() set need repo_files = None.
READING_RULES lives in briefs.rs, not in the budgeted reader prompt.
test_support.rs CutoverFixture holds job commits and landing-record commits on athena/records, with no intervention commit and no retry-after-block landing.
A background command's output file is outside the working directory, so the Read tool denies it; the completion notice is the only signal.
desires: Read access to a background command's output file, to see the full-suite output directly.
